FactionDwarves.style: Defensive. Protect economy and allies, build a durable army, counterattack when ready. Exploit a clear opportunity instead of waiting forever.

FactionWild.style: Very aggressive. Maintain cheap mass production and multiple raids. Accept losses but do not abandon a critically threatened home base.

FactionMordor.style: Very aggressive mass army. Replace losses quickly, apply constant pressure, add monsters and siege later. Respond to serious home threats.

FactionElves.style: Balanced and careful. Protect ranged units, preserve veteran forces, support allies and avoid unfavorable engagements.

FactionMen.style: Balanced combined arms, steady economy, help allies when spare forces are available. Adapt targets to observed threats.

FactionIsengard.style: Balanced efficient combined arms. Develop upgrades and counters, coordinate a strong attack without sacrificing home defence.

FactionAngmar.style: Assemble a powerful mixed army. Favor coordinated attacks over small sacrificial raids; retreat to rebuild when outmatched.
